call_points.text: About ₹2,000 Cr of the FY26 sanctions is undisbursed; ₹1,500 Cr of it is expected within the next two quarters.
Prepayments of ₹1,105 Cr and total repayments of ₹1,441 Cr moderated AUM; prepayments are not predictable.
The company holds ₹1,800 Cr of liquidity and did not borrow in FY26; fresh borrowing will wait for disbursement needs.
NIM rose to 4.49% from 4.25%; the base rate was cut 60 bps and cost of funds is expected to fall on fresh borrowing.
Q4 yield on the earning portfolio softened to 10.29% from 11.27% a year ago.
CRISIL removed the rating from 'Watch with Developing Implications' and reaffirmed CRISIL A (Negative)/A1.
MD & CEO R. Balaji resigned for personal reasons and serves till 30 June; the board has started the replacement process.
